breadcrumbTitle: A0, A1, A2 Poster on A4
title: Print an A1, A0 or A2 Poster on A4 Sheets — How Many Pages?
description: How many A4 or Letter sheets does an A0, A1, A2 or A3 poster need? Exact sheet counts, plus a free tool that tiles your poster at full size.
h1: Print an A0, A1 or A2 Poster on A4 Sheets
lead: Print a full-size A1 (59.4 × 84.1 cm), A0 or A2 poster on an ordinary A4 or US Letter printer. Load your image or PDF, pick the poster size, and the tool calculates the grid with margins and glue overlap included.

sections.heading: How many A4 sheets for an A0, A1, A2 or A3 poster?
paragraphs: On paper, the arithmetic looks simple: A1 is two A2s, four A3s, or eight A4s. In practice a home printer cannot print to the edge, and the sheets need an overlap to be glued, so each A4 covers only about 19 × 27.7 cm of the poster. The table below is calculated with exactly the same geometry the tool uses.

sections.heading: Worked example: an A1 poster on A4
paragraphs: An A1 poster is 594 × 841 mm. With a 5 mm printer margin, each portrait A4 sheet can print 200 × 287 mm; after the 10 mm glue overlap it advances 190 mm across and 277 mm down. Four columns (4 × 190 + 10 = 770 mm) cover the 594 mm width and three rows (3 × 277 + 10 = 841 mm) cover the height: a 4 × 3 grid of 12 sheets. The same poster in landscape orientation would need 15, so Auto picks portrait.
An A2 poster needs 8 A4 sheets, an A0 needs 21. If you have an A3 printer, the numbers drop to 4, 6 and 9 sheets for A2, A1 and A0.

sections.heading: Exact A-size or "about that big"?
paragraphs: For a PDF that already is A1 or A0 — a scientific poster, a plan, a map — use "PDF at 100%": the page is printed at its real physical size and the vector graphics stay sharp. For a photo or an image with a different shape, the A-size buttons set the poster width; the height follows the image proportions, so the result is A1-wide rather than exactly A1.
Print a test page first and measure the 50 mm ruler on the assembly map. If it measures 50 mm, every sheet is at true scale.

faqs.q: How many A4 sheets make an A1 poster?
faqs.a: In theory 8, but with printer margins and a 10 mm glue overlap you need 12 sheets in a 4 × 3 grid. On US Letter it is 15.

faqs.q: How many A4 sheets make an A0 poster?
faqs.a: 21 sheets (a 3 × 7 grid in landscape orientation) with 5 mm margins and 10 mm overlap. With an A3 printer, 9 sheets.

faqs.q: Can I reduce the number of sheets?
faqs.a: Lower the glue overlap or the printer margin if your printer supports it, or let the tool skip blank sheets. Do not use "Fit to page" in the print dialog — that changes the scale.

faqs.q: Is the printed poster exactly A1 size?
faqs.a: For a PDF printed at 100%, yes — the tiles are placed to the millimetre. Check the 50 mm calibration ruler after printing; printers that silently shrink pages will show it immediately.
